official: 羽村市家庭的保育事業等の設備及び運営に関する基準を定める条例及び羽村市乳児等通園支援事業の設備及び運営に関する基準を定める条例の一部を改正する条例
name: 保育事業の基準に性暴力防止規定を追加
summary: 家庭的保育事業などの設備・運営基準を定める条例に、児童対象性暴力等の防止に関する規定を加えます。乳児等通園支援事業の基準を定める条例にも規定を加え、施行日は2026年12月25日です。
changes: 各事業の設備・運営基準に児童対象性暴力等の防止規定を加える
who: 乳児等通園支援事業者
why: 法律の成立に伴い、関係する府省令に児童対象性暴力等の防止に関する規定が追加されるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Adds provisions on preventing sexual violence against children to childcare service standards
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Establishing Standards for Equipment and Operation of Hamura City Home-Based Childcare Services, etc., and the Ordinance Establishing Standards for Equipment and Operation of Hamura City Infant, etc. Childcare Support Services
en.summary: Adds provisions on preventing sexual violence against children, etc., to the ordinance establishing standards for the equipment and operation of home-based childcare services, etc. It also adds provisions to the ordinance establishing standards for infant, etc. childcare support services. The effective date is December 25, 2026.
changes: Add provisions on preventing sexual violence against children, etc., to the equipment and operation standards for each service
who: Infant, etc. childcare support service providers
en.why: The city says this is because, following the enactment of a law, provisions on preventing sexual violence against children, etc., will be added to the relevant Cabinet Office and ministry ordinances.
